mito.title: Mitochondrial Function Lab
mito.subtitle: PARL–MAVS axis × mitochondrial function in TCGA-COAD
mito.boxplot_title: Mitochondrial Function Score — High vs Low Expression
mito.summary_title: Indirect Evidence: PARL → MAVS → Mitochondrial Function
mito.summary_subtitle: If A→B is correlated and B→C is established, then A may indirectly regulate C
mito.conclusion_text: The co-expression analysis suggests that PARL and MAVS expression patterns are correlated with mitochondrial functional genes in TCGA-COAD. GSEA enrichment on co-expressed gene sets identifies mitochondrial-related pathways (OXPHOS, ROS metabolism). ssGSEA mitochondrial function scores differ between high/low expression groups, supporting the indirect regulatory axis: PARL → MAVS → Mitochondrial Function in colorectal cancer.

enrichment.no_results_hint: No enriched terms passed the adjusted p-value threshold. Try relaxing the cutoff (e.g. p < 0.1), selecting different gene set libraries, or adding more genes to your list (minimum 3 recommended).
enrichment.error_hint: This may happen if the gene list is too short, the backend service is unavailable, or the selected libraries have no matching annotations for these genes.
enrichment.small_gene_warning: Small gene list ({{count}} genes). ORA with <15 genes often yields few or zero significant results after multiple-testing correction. Consider relaxing the p-value cutoff to p < 0.1.
enrichment.small_list_explain: Your gene list has only {{count}} genes. Over-Representation Analysis with fewer than ~15 genes rarely produces statistically significant results after multiple-testing correction — this is expected, not an error.
enrichment.near_miss_hint: These terms had the lowest adjusted p-values but did not pass your cutoff of {{cutoff}}. They may still be biologically relevant.

dnb.description: Detect disease tipping points by analyzing gene module correlation and variance across sample stages.
dnb.tipping_desc: Stage with highest composite DNB score — signals a tipping point
dnb.error_insufficient_samples: Not enough samples to compute DNB scores. The analysis requires multiple samples per stage for meaningful variance and correlation calculations. Try using a larger dataset (e.g. full TCGA cohort).
dnb.error_insufficient_stages: Not enough distinct stage groups found. DNB analysis needs at least 2 different sample stages (e.g. tumor vs. normal, or Stage I vs. Stage II) to detect tipping points.
dnb.error_generic: The analysis could not complete. This may be due to insufficient data variability, too few genes in known modules, or a backend computation error.
dnb.loading_expression: Loading expression data for DNB analysis...
dnb.needs_data_hint: DNB analysis requires expression data with clinical stage annotations. Switch to the Expression tab and load data from a data source first, then return here.

tooltips.atlas: Compare gene expression across TCGA, GEO, and custom datasets. Filter by tumor stage, MSI status, and normalization method.
tooltips.interaction: Explore protein-protein interactions (STRING-DB + BioGRID), view AlphaFold 3D structures, and analyze MAVS cleavage motifs.
tooltips.clinical: Run Kaplan-Meier survival analysis, multivariate Cox regression, and compute gene-gene synergy scores using Lifelines.
tooltips.discovery: AI-powered literature mining via Gemini. Queries PubMed, validates PMIDs, scores novelty, and flags unverified claims.
tooltips.drugs: Explore drug-gene interactions from DrugBank, PubChem compounds, ChEMBL bioactivity assays, and CTD associations. Research use only.
tooltips.publication: Build publication-ready multi-panel figures. Choose layout grid, journal style, color palette, and export as PDF or SVG.
tooltips.settings: Configure your project: manage data sources, protein targets, and project metadata.
tooltips.enrichment: Run gene set enrichment analysis (ORA) against GO, KEGG, Reactome, and MSigDB Hallmark. Identifies enriched biological pathways in your gene list.
tooltips.pdm: Store and manage wet-lab experimental data. Track CCK-8/wound healing/colony assays, catalog Western Blot/IF/IHC images, and monitor animal model experiments.
tooltips.crossval: Bridge your dry-lab bioinformatics results with wet-lab experimental evidence. See concordance levels, gene-level evidence maps, and overlay details.
tooltips.dnb: Detect disease tipping points using Dynamic Network Biomarker analysis. Identifies gene modules whose correlation structure changes across disease stages.
tooltips.mito: PARL/MAVS co-expression analysis, mitochondrial gene correlations, and ssGSEA function scoring in TCGA-COAD. Supports the indirect evidence chain A→B→C narrative.
